subject: Intro: Tideway (healthcare AI) — AWS co-sell intake and kickoff request
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tideway.health>, Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@tideway.health>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Tideway (healthcare AI) — AWS co-sell intake and kickoff request

Hi Samir / Priya —

Great to connect at HLTH last week. As discussed, Redwood Inference can help Tideway scale inference for your clinical summarization and de-identification workflows with predictable latency on GPU-backed hosts and an AWS Marketplace listing to simplify procurement.

Would love to get a short intro call with your procurement / cloud ops team and loop in Alicia from AWS to discuss co-sell runway and the mutual action plan. Proposed agenda (30 min):
- Brief tech overview & deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated)
- Marketplace listing & procurement steps
- AWS co-sell handoff: AM & partner manager roles
- Initial rollout timeline + MAP milestones

I attached a draft MAP and a checklist for the AWS listing. Are you available Tuesday 4/20 at 10:00am PT or Wednesday 4/21 at 2:00pm PT? If those don't work, propose two times that do.

Next steps if you confirm: I’ll loop in Kimberly (internal procurement lead) and Karthik (solutions) to cover onboarding and security gate items (SOC2, data handling).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Tideway_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft, 2 pages), redwood-aws-co-sell-checklist.xlsx (checklist)
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@amazon.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@tideway.health>
Date: 2027-04-17T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Tideway (healthcare AI) — AWS co-sell intake and kickoff request

Hi all —

Thanks for the intro, Mateo. Happy to help run the co-sell intake. I can join either 4/20 10am PT or 4/21 2pm PT; preference for 4/21 2pm PT so I can align with the AWS AM (Jordan Lee).

Pre-read for the call: please share a short deck of the customer problem (1–2 slides), 30-day pilot goals, and the current procurement contact. Also confirm whether Tideway will need a marketplace listing or if you prefer a private marketplace procurement first — both are possible but cadence differs.

I can also run an initial QuickStart with our marketplace enablement team once we confirm the MAP milestones.

—
Alicia Ramos
Partner Solutions Manager, AWS
Alicia.Ramos@amazon.com
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tideway.health>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@amazon.com>
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@tideway.health>
Date: 2027-04-18T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Tideway (healthcare AI) — AWS co-sell intake and kickoff request

Hi Mateo / Alicia —

Thanks — 4/21 at 2pm PT works for us. Priya (cc’d) will be the procurement lead. I’ll send calendar invites once you confirm the meeting link.

Quick notes before the call:
- We want to prioritize a pilot on EMR inference (FHIR-based summaries) — target: 1M tokens/day during pilot.
- Security: Tideway has a GDPR/SOC2 compliance baseline; we’ll need an evidence pack for the AWS team.
- Procurement: prefer Marketplace listing if it won’t delay the pilot by >6 weeks; otherwise we can do an SOW and transition to marketplace later.

See you on Wednesday.

—
Samir Patel
Head of Platform | Tideway Health
samir.patel@tideway.health
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tideway.health>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Tideway (healthcare AI) — AWS co-sell intake and kickoff request

Perfect — thanks Samir. I’ve tentatively booked 4/21 2:00pm PT (invites to follow).

Kimberly / Karthik — looping you both in: Kimberly, can your team prepare a short procurement checklist and pricing cadence for a Marketplace listing vs. direct SOW? Karthik, please be ready to walk through the deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private VPC) and initial perf targets.

The attached MAP is our proposed set of milestones — pilot kickoff, security gate review, pilot completion, marketplace listing submission, co-sell enablement. We’ll use the shared Drive folder (link below) for artifacts; I’ll capture action items in HubSpot.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Tideway-AWS-Map
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-7890
DocuSign (MSA template when ready): https://docusign.com/link/placeholder

Action items before Wed:
- Tideway: confirm pilot scope + procurement contact (Samir/Priya)
- Redwood: procurement checklist (Kimberly), deployment notes and perf targets (Karthik)
- AWS: confirm AM + co-sell readiness (Alicia)

Thanks everyone — see you Wednesday.

—
Mateo
From: Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@tideway.health>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@amazon.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@tideway.health>
Date: 2027-04-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Tideway (healthcare AI) — AWS co-sell intake and kickoff request

Thanks — calendar invite received and confirmed for 4/21 2pm PT. Looking forward to the kickoff. Priya (procurement) will bring the current procurement timeline; Samir will bring the technical scope.

If you need any pre-reads from our side, let me know — otherwise we’ll review the MAP on the call.

—
Priya Nambiar
Procurement Manager | Tideway Health
priya.nambiar@tideway.health
